partition_rule: material + optional + false_positive = Q1..Q8 for every case; unlisted questions are false positives

label_map.seven-question responses: when gold Q8 is material, a selected Q7 also satisfies Q8 and leaves the false-positive set unless Q7 is itself material or optional; when gold Q8 is optional, a selected Q7 is untallied (neither TP nor FP); otherwise labels are scored as written. No-skill responses get no map. Applied mechanically by evals/aggregate.py.

authority: This file is the authoritative gold set; the case list in EVALS.md is a rendered view of it. Routing precision/recall are computed by evals/aggregate.py, never by the judge.
aggregation: macro average per case and version; empty-gold cases score P=R=1.0 when nothing is selected, else 0; chains n/a on empty-gold cases
gold_history_contract: gold_history entries store previous/current material and optional sets with effective_from; aggregate.py --as-of DATE reverts entries later than DATE, latest first. must_cover_history is a record of wording changes; the scorer warns when the as-of wording differs from the wording the judges scored, it does not rescore coverage. A case reported in a round keeps its gold for that round; changes derived while the round is open live under proposed_gold_changes and are applied only before the next round. Applying a proposal to a held-out case moves that case to Dev.
contamination_rule: a gold changed by reference to a held-out case moves that case out of the held-out set; rationales therefore cite must_cover content, not sibling cases
frozen_gold_rule: a case reported in a round keeps its gold for that round. Each gold_history entry carries recorded_on (when it was written) and effective_from (first round date it is in force for); a change must be recorded before the round it first applies to. Entries with kind 'relabel' (pure taxonomy renames that change no required content) are exempt. aggregate.py --as-of errors when a reported case has a non-relabel entry in force (effective_from <= as-of) that was recorded on or after the as-of date

meta_contract: each generator writes <case>-<label>.meta.json with selected_questions (list), unknown_questions (list, questions marked unknown rather than selected), and files_read (absolute paths); routed integrity is checked against selected_questions plus unknown_questions
